bandReport.notes: Items 1-22 across pages 1-5, contiguous with no skipped numbers. Page 1 opens at item 1 (whole) and page 5 ends with item 22 whole — its option (d) and the page footer are both on page 5, so nothing continues onto page 6. Item 23 begins on page 6 (not this band). Layout is a uniform 2 questions per column, except page 5 which runs 3 left (18-20) / 2 right (21-22). COLUMN CROPS: all ten crops for pages 1-5 were checked and none is sliced — no question line is cut down its middle and every c2 opens on its own item number. On p04 the detected split sits slightly LEFT of the true gutter, so p04-c2 carries a narrow strip of the LEFT column's line-END letters down its far edge ('nk', 'e to', 'ven', 'of', 'for', 'Ms', 'ed', 'dia'); that is the expected overlap, not a slice — items 16 and 17 are whole within p04-c2, and items 13-15 are whole within p04-c1. Each page was additionally cross-checked against pNN.png for item order and gutter-spanning content; none spans the gutter. PRINTED ODDITIES: none material. Item 22 prints its pairs as a two-column 'Tradition / State' grid with an em-dash joining each pair; transcribed as a GFM pipe table with the mandatory separator row, printed order preserved. Item 3 prints '70th' with a superscript 'th'; transcribed as plain '70th'. Item 8's word 'is' in statement 1 carries a stray ink speck below it in the scan (a scan artefact, not printed text). No duplicated option, no missing fourth option, no garbled stem anywhere in the band; every item has exactly four options (a)-(d) in printed order. SUBTOPIC WARNINGS (soft, not in catalog.json): item 3 uses 'Agricultural Households and Rural Incomes' under Economy > Agriculture and Rural Economy — the NSSO 70th Round Situation Assessment Survey of Agricultural Households has no listed subtopic that fits; the nearest listed alternative would be 'Economic Surveys and Reports', but that sits under a different chapter and would file an agriculture question away from agriculture. All other subject/chapter/subtopic values are copied verbatim from catalog.json.
